messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
எங்கள் வாழ்க்கையின் பாதையின் நடுவில் நான் ஒரு இருண்ட காடில் என்னை கண்டேன், அதனால் சரியான பாதை தவறாகி விட்டது.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG] After the table, list any MISSING or WRONG items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Tamil) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | **Nel** | preposition + article “in the” (locative head) | **நடுவில்** | “in the middle / midway” | OK | | **mezzo** | noun “middle point” (midway) | **நடுவில்** | “midway” | OK | | **del** | preposition + article marking genitive “of the” | **வாழ்க்கையின்** | “of life” | OK | | **cammin** | noun “road / path” (the journey) | **பாதையின்** | “of the path” | OK | | **di** | preposition linking possessive “of” | **வாழ்க்கையின்** | “of life” | OK | | **nostra** | possessive adjective “our” | **எங்கள்** | “our” | OK | | **vita** | noun “life” (span of existence) | **வாழ்க்கை** | “life” | OK | | **mi** | reflexive pronoun “myself” | **என்னை** | “myself” | OK | | **ritrovai** | verb “found (myself)” (passato remoto) | **கண்டேன்** | “found” | OK | | **per** | preposition with locative value “within” | **காடில்** | “in the forest” | OK | | **una** | indefinite article “a” | **ஒரு** | “a / one” | OK | | **selva** | noun “forest / wood” | **காடு** | “forest / wood” | OK | | **oscura** | adjective “dark” | **இருண்ட** | “dark” | OK | | **ché** | conjunction “for / because” (causal) | **அதனால்** | “because / so” | OK | | **la** | definite article “the” (specifies the way) | *(none – Tamil has no article)* | – | **MISSING** | | **diritta** | adjective “right / straight / correct” | **சரியான** | “right / correct” | OK | | **via** | noun “way / path” | **பாதை** | “way / path” | OK | | **era** | copular verb “was / had been” (imperfect) | **விட்டது** | “had / was” (auxiliary) | OK | | **smarrita** | past participle adjective “lost / missed” | **தவறாகி** | “missed / gone astray” | OK |
---
### Missing / Problematic Items - **la** – Tamil does not use definite articles, so no direct lexical counterpart appears in the translation. The meaning is still conveyed by the adjective **சரியான**, but the article itself is absent.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING or WRONG items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Output per line: Line #, Original Translation, Issues, Corrected Translation (if any). Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

**Line 1** - **Original Translation:** எங்கள் வாழ்க்கையின் பாதையின் நடுவில் - **Issues:** None - **Corrected Translation:** (no change)
**Line 2** - **Original Translation:** நான் ஒரு இருண்ட காடில் என்னை கண்டேன், - **Issues:** None - **Corrected Translation:** (no change)
**Line 3** - **Original Translation:** அதனால் சரியான பாதை தவறாகி விட்டது. - **Issues:** Missing definite article “la”. - **Corrected Translation:** அதனால் **அந்த** சரியான பாதை தவறாகி விட்டது.
```text எங்கள் வாழ்க்கையின் பாதையின் நடுவில் நான் ஒரு இருண்ட காடில் என்னை கண்டேன், அதனால் அந்த சரியான பாதை தவறாகி விட்டது. ```
